data.name: PENNSACO TECHNOLOGIES
data.description: Pennsaco Technologies is a Radnor, Pennsylvania company (founded 2018) developing a waste-to-hydrogen thermal conversion process whose biochar co-product is marketed as permanent carbon removal. Public activity peaked in 2021–2022 with a Latin America MOU and plans for a plant at Kansas' Great Plains Industrial Park; no subsequent deployments, funding rounds, or significant news have surfaced, and third-party data shows headcount of only 1–5 employees.
